rationale: The stock has gapped up 44% on an acquisition announcement and is currently trading in a tight, low-volatility consolidation range (ATR $0.02) immediately after the open. Entering a long position at the high of the day offers a poor risk-reward profile due to the high probability of mean reversion or a "sell the news" dump, while shorting a gap-up M&A event carries extreme gap risk and potential short-squeeze dynamics that are not suitable for intraday risk management.
